records.theme: 斯梅里克投降后约六百人遭英军杀害

records.theme: 德雷克占领并勒索圣多明各

records.explanation: do not add to treasure seized or recognize amount as audited English state profit

records.theme: 英军攻破卡里加福伊尔城堡，处死残存守军

records.underlying_archive_note: Irish OPW official Carrigafoyle Castle history lists fifty Irish defenders
records.explanation: Do not assert 50 confirmed separately killed: some perished in collapsed wall, survivors executed; exact named fatality roll unavailable. Combined with M16 = sixty-six armed defenders before assault not deaths.

records.theme: 英军攻破卡里加福伊尔城堡，处死残存守军

records.explanation: Combined 50+16 is a nominal defended force, NOT confirmed execution toll. Noncombatants unspecified.

records.theme: 英军官员报告芒斯特严重饥荒与人口死亡
records.unit: people claimed dead during six-month 1581–82 period
records.quantifier: St Leger contemporary estimate; McCormack 2004 peer reviewed treats as an upper-limit, independently unverified
records.underlying_archive_note: TNA SP63/91/41 dated March12 and April20 1582 (as cited McCormack note77); reported famine/disease deaths in region not named-person census
records.explanation: Upper bound according to McCormack, NOT established true toll, no independent addition to war deaths or 1580 Smerwick; cannot allocate deaths proportionally by modern Munster counties.

records.theme: 德雷克英军袭击维戈，纵火焚烧民居和教堂

records.explanation: Do not sum 270 vs 570 alternative estimates or use value as city-wide verified property destruction

records.theme: 英王批准芒斯特殖民地契：分配庄园、设租并排除本地爱尔兰人的承领权
records.unit: historical English pounds/shillings/pence per year beginning Michaelmas 1590
records.quantifier: original 27 June 1586 plantation articles, nominal future annual rent fixed for 1590–1593 then twice rates from 1593
records.underlying_archive_note: UCC CELT Desmond Survey ¶366, region: Cork, Tipperary and Waterford
records.explanation: This is a prospective legal rate, NOT evidence that Crown collected this sum in any year of 1580s; no price inflation and no GBP decimal conversion. The per-seignory 12000-acre basis is not any actual landed grant tally.
